driver.name: Matteo Varrone
driver.bio: Saetta's golden boy; brakes later than anyone and apologises to no one.
driver.background: Born in Modena, son of a Saetta machinist; in the team academy from fourteen.
driver.personality: Hot-blooded on the radio, adored by the home fans; kisses the lightning bolt on his helmet before every start.
